categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文集中在能力评测基准、隐私与安全机制，以及低资源语言和结构化生成等落地适配方向。

articles.title: TID System for Speech-COSER Challenge 2026: ASR Track
articles.zh: 面向 Speech-COSER Challenge 2026 的 TID 系统：ASR 赛道
articles.summary: 如果你在搭多语言/复杂场景语音识别系统，这篇给出一套完整的竞赛级工程方案，可直接当作可复现的 baseline 参考
articles.author: Fernando López, Jordi Luque
articles.body: We describe the system submitted by Telefónica Innovación Digital to the Speech-COSER Challenge 2026, which features spontaneous speech from elderly speakers recorded in rural Spain. For ASR, we perform CTC-based pseudo-forced alignment scores audio-text match quality to guide a two-stage LoRA curriculum, followed by post-hoc magnitude pruning of the LoRA matrices to enhance generalization. An ensemble of seven systems combined via ROVER achieves 36.25\% unnormalized and 22.17\% normalized WER.
articles.bodyZh: 我们介绍的是 Telefónica Innovación Digital 提交给 Speech-COSER Challenge 2026 的系统，这个挑战赛用的是西班牙农村地区录制的老年人自然口语语音。在自动语音识别（ASR）方面，我们用基于 CTC（连接时序分类）的伪强制对齐分数来衡量音频和文本的匹配程度，并用它指导两阶段的 LoRA（低秩适配）课程式训练；之后对 LoRA 矩阵做事后幅度剪枝，以提升泛化能力。最后把七个系统集成起来，用 ROVER 融合，得到未归一化词错误率（WER）36.25%、归一化 WER 22.17%。

articles.title: THEATRON: A Benchmark for Evaluating Persona Persistence in Long-Horizon LLM Decision-Making
articles.zh: THEATRON：评估长程 LLM 决策中人格（persona）持续性的基准
articles.summary: 如果你打算让 Agent 顶着固定人设跑长任务，这个 benchmark 会告诉你它到底能撑几轮才"出戏"
articles.author: Yuyan Wang, Yuechen Jiang 等
articles.body: Existing evaluations often test persona expression rather than whether persona information persists in extended decision-making. We introduce THEATRON, a controlled benchmark that uses financial replay to evaluate persona persistence in long-horizon sequential decision-making. In these environments, models conditioned on fixed behavioral-finance personas observe shared daily market evidence and trajectory-specific account-state feedback and make sequential decisions over multi-month trajectories. We evaluate Zero-Shot, One-Shot, and Chain-of-Thought persona injection across four LLMs, using cumulative-return and action trajectories to diagnose within-persona stability, cross-persona separability, and action collapse. Persona conditioning produces systematic behavioral shifts beyond a no-persona baseline, and persona-level separation generally exceeds the variation induced by semantically equivalent descriptions. Nevertheless, these shifts do not reliably form coherent persona-specific policies: apparently stable separation can arise from stereotyped action collapse, while diverse policies can exhibit noisy trajectory switching. These findings expose a gap between observable persona-induced behavior and persistent, context-sensitive persona-conditioned decision policies. Code and benchmark data are publicly available at: https://github.com/yuyan12138/theatron
articles.bodyZh: 现有评测往往只看模型能不能“演”出某个人设，而不看人设信息在更长的决策过程里到底能不能一直保留。我们提出 THEATRON，这是一个受控基准（benchmark），用金融场景回放来评估长周期、连续决策中的人设持续性（persona persistence）。在这些环境里，模型会被设定成具有行为金融学特征的人设（behavioral-finance personas），看到相同的每日市场证据，也会收到各自轨迹对应的账户状态反馈，然后要在跨好几个月的轨迹上连续做决策。我们用四种大语言模型（LLM）评测零样本（Zero-Shot）、单样本（One-Shot）和思维链（Chain-of-Thought）三种人设注入方式，并用累计收益（cumulative return）和动作轨迹（action trajectories）来诊断人设内部稳定性（within-persona stability）、跨人设可分性（cross-persona separability）以及动作崩塌（action collapse）。给人设条件确实会让模型相比没有人设的基线产生系统性行为变化，而且不同人设之间的区分度通常大于语义等价描述带来的波动。但是，这些变化并不能稳定形成一套连贯的、人设专属的决策策略：看起来稳定的区分，可能只是刻板化的动作崩塌造成的；而策略看起来多样，又可能表现为轨迹上嘈杂的来回切换（trajectory switching）。这些发现说明，模型表现出来的人设诱发行为，和真正持久、能随情境变化、由人设条件驱动的决策策略之间，还存在一道鸿沟。代码和基准数据公开在：https://github.com/yuyan12138/theatron

articles.title: Robust and Private Swarm Learning via Zero-Knowledge Validator Admission and Consensus Aggregation
articles.zh: 基于零知识验证者准入与共识聚合的鲁棒隐私群体学习
articles.summary: 如果你在做去中心化的联邦/群体学习，又担心恶意节点混入和隐私外泄，这套 ZKP 卡准入 + 共识聚合的组合拳值得借鉴
articles.author: Marco Arazzi, Mert Cihangiroglu 等
articles.body: Swarm Learning improves resilience and removes the need for a single trusted coordinator by distributing model aggregation and validation across participating nodes. However, it also delegates the validation of model updates to peers whose private data may be biased, unrepresentative, or adversarial, and existing Swarm Learning protocols generally do not attest that data, leaving decentralized validation as an attack surface. We present a robust, privacy-preserving Swarm Learning framework that makes verifiable data quality the condition for admission to the learning task. A validator joins only after a zero-knowledge attestation proves, without revealing any raw sample, that a reference model ran correctly on its private data. The attested outputs also yield a label-free class profile, so the network assembles a collectively IID validator pool from individually skewed validators as accurately as an oracle with the true labels (total-variation distance to uniform 0.025, against 0.021 for the oracle and 0.21 for random selection). Admitted validators score client updates and, through a Tendermint-style Byzantine Fault Tolerant consensus, agree on a gradient mask and a quality-derived aggregation weight for each submission, replacing dataset-size weighting with a quality-aware signal. Adapting the cut-layer idea of Split Learning, a challenge-based audit lets peers re-verify that a mask was computed on the attested data without an expensive end-to-end zero-knowledge proof. Across four benchmarks under non-IID partitions the framework matches FedAvg on clean data; under a gradient-scaling attack that collapses FedAvg to random chance, it retains 94% of clean accuracy on CIFAR-100 and over 99% on FashionMNIST, where FedAvg achieves only 2.1% and 11%. The result is a private, robust, and auditable foundation for decentralized learning.
articles.bodyZh:
群体学习（Swarm Learning）把模型聚合和验证分散到各个参与节点上，因此抗打击能力更强，也不再需要一个受信任的中心协调者。但它也把模型更新的验证工作交给了同伴，而这些同伴的私有数据可能有偏差、不具代表性，甚至可能是对抗性的；现有群体学习协议通常不会对这些数据做认证，于是去中心化验证本身就成了一个攻击面。

我们提出一个稳健、保护隐私的群体学习框架，把“数据质量可验证”作为进入学习任务的前提条件。一个验证者只有在零知识认证（zero-knowledge attestation）证明——在不泄露任何原始样本的情况下——某个参考模型确实在其私有数据上正确运行之后，才能加入。认证后的输出还会生成一个不含标签的类别画像（class profile），于是网络能从各自有偏的验证者中，拼出一个整体上独立同分布（IID）的验证者池，准确度接近知道真实标签的理想参照（oracle）：与均匀分布的总变差距离（total-variation distance）为 0.025，理想参照是 0.021，随机挑选则是 0.21。

获准加入的验证者会给客户端的更新打分，并通过 Tendermint 风格的拜占庭容错共识（Byzantine Fault Tolerant consensus），对每次提交的梯度掩码（gradient mask）和由数据质量推导出的聚合权重（aggregation weight）达成一致，用质量感知信号取代按数据集大小加权。框架借鉴拆分学习（Split Learning）里的切割层（cut-layer）思路，用基于挑战的审计（challenge-based audit）让同伴能够重新核验：某个掩码确实是在已认证的数据上计算出来的，而且不需要昂贵、端到端的零知识证明。

在非独立同分布（non-IID）数据划分下的四个基准测试里，这个框架在干净数据上和联邦平均（FedAvg）表现相当；但在一种能把 FedAvg 打到随机瞎猜水平的梯度缩放攻击（gradient-scaling attack）下，它在 CIFAR-100 上仍保住 94% 的干净数据准确率，在 FashionMNIST 上超过 99%，而 FedAvg 分别只有 2.1% 和 11%。这就为去中心化学习打下了一个既保护隐私、又稳健、还可审计的基础。

articles.title: Saidzoda-CA-EmbeddingGemma-300M: One Small Embedder for Tajik, Kazakh, Uzbek and Kyrgyz
articles.zh: Saidzoda-CA-EmbeddingGemma-300M：一个覆盖塔吉克语、哈萨克语、乌兹别克语、吉尔吉斯语的小型嵌入模型
articles.summary: 如果你要处理中亚低资源语言的检索或聚类，这说明 300M 的小 embedder 就够用，不必硬上大模型
articles.author: Tohir Saidzoda, Nekruz Maxudov 等
articles.body: The small open embedder EmbeddingGemma-300M, used as released, finds the right passage first for only 51.7% to 60.8% of Belebele questions in Tajik, Kazakh, Uzbek and Kyrgyz. We present Saidzoda-CA-EmbeddingGemma-300M, one model for all four languages. It is our Tajik fine-tune of EmbeddingGemma-300M, trained for one more epoch on 279,904 pairs: questions in Kazakh, Uzbek and Kyrgyz that our own language model wrote about source passages, a Tajik refresher, and English and Russian replay. On Belebele, recall@1 rises by 14.4 to 26.0 points in each language, to between 75.2% and 77.7%. Against single-language models trained with the same settings, the one model stays within 2.8 points at recall@1 in Kazakh, Uzbek and Tajik, with overlapping recall@10 intervals, though it also had more training. It keeps the Tajik law recall@10 of its starting point (92.2 against 92.4) but loses 4.4 points of law recall@1. A model trained on one of these languages also improves the others on Belebele, but less than training on them. The model still trails the 560M XLM-RoBERTa embedders on Kazakh, Uzbek and Kyrgyz Belebele: the better of multilingual-e5-large-instruct and BGE-M3, used as released, is 9.4 to 10.2 points ahead at recall@1. Our scores of those released models agree with the published MTEB results within 2.4 points. Russian and English recall@1 fall by 3.0 and 4.2 points.
articles.bodyZh: 这个直接按发布版本使用的小型开源嵌入模型（embedder）EmbeddingGemma-300M，在塔吉克语、哈萨克语、乌兹别克语和吉尔吉斯语的 Belebele 问题里，只有51.7%到60.8%的情况能第一次就找对段落。我们推出 Saidzoda-CA-EmbeddingGemma-300M，一个模型覆盖这四种语言。它是在 EmbeddingGemma-300M 基础上做的塔吉克语微调（fine-tune），又用279,904个数据对（pairs）多训练了一轮（epoch）：包括我们自己的语言模型围绕原始段落写出的哈萨克语、乌兹别克语和吉尔吉斯语问题，一份塔吉克语巩固数据，以及英语和俄语回放数据。在 Belebele 上，每种语言的召回率@1（recall@1）都提高了14.4到26.0个百分点，达到75.2%到77.7%。跟同样设置训练出来的单语模型比，这个统一模型在哈萨克语、乌兹别克语和塔吉克语上的 recall@1 差距在2.8个百分点以内，召回率@10（recall@10）的区间也互相重叠——不过它训练得也更多。它保住了起点模型在塔吉克语法律任务上的 recall@10（92.2 对 92.4），但法律任务的 recall@1 掉了4.4个百分点。只用其中一种语言训练出来的模型，也能提升其他语言在 Belebele 上的表现，但不如直接用这些语言训练来得明显。这个模型在哈萨克语、乌兹别克语和吉尔吉斯语的 Belebele 上，还是落后于560M的 XLM-RoBERTa 嵌入模型：按原样使用的 multilingual-e5-large-instruct 和 BGE-M3 里，表现更好的那个在 recall@1 上领先9.4到10.2个百分点。我们给这些已发布模型打的分，和公开的 MTEB 结果相差不超过2.4个百分点。俄语和英语的 recall@1 分别掉了3.0和4.2个百分点。

articles.title: GOPR-CAD: Graph-of-Operations Progressive Reasoning for CAD Generation
articles.zh: GOPR-CAD：面向 CAD 生成的操作图渐进式推理
articles.summary: 如果你想让模型吐出可编辑的 CAD 建模操作序列、而不是只画个大概形状，操作图加渐进推理这条路线值得盯
articles.author: Yitian Pang, Yifan Li 等
articles.body: Generating accurate CAD models requires substantial engineering expertise and careful control of geometry, topology, and mechanical constraints. Text-to-CAD aims to simplify this process, but current LLM-based methods often generate CAD programs directly. Language models remain unreliable when producing long code while coordinating coupled geometric, topological, and dimensional constraints. Consequently, executable programs may still produce structurally incorrect models, which execution rate and rendered appearance may fail to reveal. To address these limitations, we propose GOPR-CAD, an agentic Text-to-CAD pipeline based on Graph-of-Operations Progressive Reasoning. A language model acts as a decision agent over encapsulated CAD operations and progressively constructs an executable operation graph, which a deterministic compiler converts into the final CAD model. This separation requires no additional training and supports different language models. To evaluate structural fidelity, we construct MHCAD, a benchmark of 300 standard mechanical part requirements derived from Machinery's Handbook. Their explicit structures enable reference-free STEP/B-rep evaluation. GOPR-CAD achieves 82.7% Structural Yield on MHCAD, and 87.2% Structural Yield on an external CADPrompt subset.
articles.bodyZh: 要想生成准确的 CAD（计算机辅助设计）模型，得有扎实的工程经验，还得把几何、拓扑和机械约束都控制得很细。Text-to-CAD（文本生成 CAD）就是想把这个过程简化，但现在基于 LLM（大语言模型）的方法，常常是直接生成 CAD 程序。可语言模型在写长代码、还要同时协调互相耦合的几何、拓扑和尺寸约束时，依然不太靠得住。所以，程序虽然能执行，产出的模型结构却可能不对，而执行成功率或者渲染出来的外观，未必能看出这个问题。为了补上这些短板，我们提出了 GOPR-CAD，这是一种基于操作图渐进推理（Graph-of-Operations Progressive Reasoning）的智能体式 Text-to-CAD 流水线。让语言模型扮演决策智能体，在封装好的 CAD 操作上做选择，一步步构建出可执行的操作图，再由一个确定性编译器（deterministic compiler）把它转成最终的 CAD 模型。这种拆分不需要额外训练，也能支持不同的语言模型。为了评估结构保真度，我们构建了 MHCAD，这是一个包含 300 个标准机械零件需求的基准集，需求都来自《机械设计手册》（Machinery's Handbook）。这些需求的结构写得很明确，所以可以做无参考的 STEP/B-rep（边界表示）评估。GOPR-CAD 在 MHCAD 上达到 82.7% 的结构产出率（Structural Yield），在外部 CADPrompt 子集上达到 87.2% 的结构产出率。

articles.title: RealEmbedBench: Benchmarking LLMs on Real-World Application-Layer Embedded Software Tasks
articles.zh: RealEmbedBench：在真实应用层嵌入式软件任务上评测 LLM
articles.summary: 如果你以为 LLM 已经能接手嵌入式开发，这个基准会用真实应用层任务给你泼一盆冷水
articles.author: Yujun Huang, Yuwei Zhang 等
articles.body: Large language models (LLMs) perform well on general coding tasks, but their capabilities in application-layer embedded software development remain underexplored. Existing embedded benchmarks primarily focus on hardware-in-the-loop validation in simulated environments. We introduce RealEmbedBench, a benchmark of 5,142 samples covering three application-layer tasks: code generation and completion, state machine modeling and implementation, and cross-OS code translation. We evaluate six representative LLMs and find substantial performance differences across tasks and models. Project context, especially the local code window, significantly affects code generation and completion. Models perform reasonably well at state machine modeling but struggle to translate these models into executable code. Cross-OS translation performance varies substantially by direction. Translation from Harmony to RT-Thread is particularly challenging, with an average pass rate of 0.1667. These findings suggest that developers should consider local code context when using LLMs for code generation and completion and select models according to the translation direction. They also motivate the use of more real-world state machine implementation data in LLM training to narrow the gap between modeling and executable code.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型（LLMs）在通用编程任务上表现不错，但它们在应用层嵌入式软件开发上的能力，目前还研究得不够。现有的嵌入式测试基准，主要盯着模拟环境里的硬件在环（hardware-in-the-loop）验证。我们推出了 RealEmbedBench，一个包含 5,142 个样本的基准，覆盖三类应用层任务：代码生成与补全、状态机（state machine）建模与实现，以及跨操作系统（cross-OS）代码翻译。我们评测了六个有代表性的 LLM，发现不同任务、不同模型之间的性能差距很大。项目上下文，尤其是本地代码窗口（local code window），会明显影响代码生成和补全的效果。模型在状态机建模上表现还算可以，但把这些模型变成能跑的代码就比较吃力。跨 OS 翻译的表现则跟翻译方向关系很大：从 Harmony 翻到 RT-Thread 尤其难，平均通过率只有 0.1667。这些结果说明，开发者用 LLM 做代码生成和补全时，得把本地代码上下文考虑进去；做跨 OS 翻译时，也要根据翻译方向来选模型。同时，这也提醒我们，训练 LLM 时应该多加入一些真实世界里的状态机实现数据，好缩小“建模”和“可执行代码”之间的差距。

articles.title: Identifiable alignment of unpaired representations
articles.zh: 无配对表示的可辨识对齐
articles.summary: 如果你在做跨模态/跨域表示对齐却拿不到配对数据，这篇从可辨识性角度讲清了什么条件下真能对齐、什么情况只是自欺
articles.author: Stas Syrota, Albert Lopez I Serrano 等
articles.body: Aligning two models without paired data requires a distance that both share, yet existing methods use Euclidean or spherical geometry. This is either an arbitrary choice or imposed by their loss function. We show that, under a precise form of the manifold hypothesis, the pullback of the data metric gives such a distance for any two models of one data-generating process. This holds whether the models are encoders, decoders or both, and whatever their architecture, loss, prior or training data. The alignment map preserves this distance and the distribution of representations, and is identifiable if and only if the data distribution breaks every symmetry of the data manifold. We show that this symmetry breaking holds generically. Identifiability makes the alignment coupling the unique optimum of Gromov--Wasserstein and of its weighted combinations with a linear program. The linear program alone has the same optimum if almost every data point has a distinct distribution of distances. The coupling, and with it the alignment map, is recovered exactly from permuted samples, even without identifiability, and consistently from independent ones. Our method, Neural Gromov--Monge Alignment (NGMA), uses no pairs or labels and outperforms every unpaired and label-informed baseline. It relies on pullback distances to align image models with different priors and single-cell models trained on disjoint cells, where Euclidean distances fail.
articles.bodyZh: 要在没有配对数据（paired data）的情况下把两个模型对齐，就得找一个双方共享的距离；现有方法不是用欧氏几何（Euclidean geometry），就是用球面几何（spherical geometry）。这要么是随便选的，要么是被损失函数逼出来的。我们证明，在一种严格表述的流形假设（manifold hypothesis）下，数据度量（data metric）的拉回（pullback）就能给同一个数据生成过程（data-generating process）的任意两个模型提供这样一个距离。不管模型是编码器（encoder）、解码器（decoder）还是两者兼有，也不管它们用什么架构（architecture）、损失（loss）、先验（prior）或训练数据（training data），这都成立。对齐映射（alignment map）会保住这个距离，也保住表示的分布（distribution of representations）；而且，当且仅当数据分布把数据流形（data manifold）的每一个对称性（symmetry）都打破时，它才是可辨识的（identifiable）。我们还证明，这种对称性破缺（symmetry breaking）在一般情况下（generically）都成立。一旦可辨识，这个对齐耦合（alignment coupling）就是 Gromov–Wasserstein 的唯一最优解，也是它跟线性规划（linear program）做加权组合后的唯一最优解。要是几乎每个数据点的距离分布都互不相同，光靠线性规划也能得到同一个最优解。这个耦合，连同由它得到的对齐映射，即使不可辨识，也能从置换样本（permuted samples）里精确恢复；从独立样本（independent samples）里则能一致地恢复。我们的方法叫 Neural Gromov–Monge Alignment（NGMA），不用配对、也不用标签（labels），效果压过所有无配对基线和利用标签信息的基线（baseline）。它靠拉回距离来对齐先验不同的图像模型，以及在不重叠细胞（disjoint cells）上训练的单细胞（single-cell）模型；在这些地方，欧氏距离会失灵。

articles.title: MOMENT-DP: Momentum Aware Evaluation of Correlated Noise for Differentially Private Training
articles.zh: MOMENT-DP：差分隐私训练中相关噪声的动量感知评估
articles.summary: 如果你在训练里加了 DP 就默认隐私预算算得准，这篇提醒你优化器动量会让噪声产生相关性，实际保护强度弱于理论值
articles.author: Sunny Gupta, Raja Viswanadha
articles.body: Temporally correlated noise can substantially improve the utility of differentially private optimization, yet candidate mechanisms are commonly designed or evaluated using only partial information about the optimization process, such as workload structure, learning-rate schedules, or local curvature. We study whether persistent optimizer state provides additional information that can change the relative utility of privacy-valid correlated-noise mechanisms. We introduce MOMENT-DP, an optimizer-state-aware framework that models how temporally correlated privacy noise propagates through momentum-based optimization. For locally quadratic objectives, MOMENT-DP expresses privacy-induced final loss through an optimizer transfer operator that jointly captures curvature, learning-rate scheduling, momentum, and temporal noise covariance. NoiseCurve's curvature-aware quadratic criterion is recovered exactly as the zero-momentum, constant-learning-rate special case. Changing only momentum while holding curvature, schedule, privacy calibration, and candidate mechanisms fixed induces genuine mechanism-ranking reversals. The effect persists outside exact quadratic dynamics in per-example-clipped private logistic regression, while remaining unresolved in the neural regime we study. These results establish optimizer state as an under-modeled, decision-relevant axis in evaluating temporally correlated privacy noise.
articles.bodyZh: 时间相关噪声（temporally correlated noise）其实能大幅提升差分隐私优化（differentially private optimization）的效用，但候选机制在设计或评估时，常常只用了优化过程的一部分信息，比如工作负载结构、学习率调度，或者局部曲率。我们研究的是：持续保留的优化器状态（persistent optimizer state）会不会提供额外信息，从而改变隐私合规的相关噪声机制（privacy-valid correlated-noise mechanisms）之间的相对效用。为此我们提出 MOMENT-DP，这是一个优化器状态感知框架（optimizer-state-aware framework），用来刻画时间相关的隐私噪声如何在基于动量的优化（momentum-based optimization）里传播。对于局部二次目标（locally quadratic objectives），MOMENT-DP 会通过一个优化器传递算子（optimizer transfer operator）来表达隐私导致的最终损失；这个算子把曲率、学习率调度、动量（momentum）和时间噪声协方差（temporal noise covariance）一起纳入进来。NoiseCurve 的曲率感知二次判据（curvature-aware quadratic criterion），正好能作为零动量、恒定学习率的特例被精确还原出来。只改动动量，其他都不动——曲率、调度、隐私校准（privacy calibration）和候选机制保持固定——就会真的导致机制排序反转（mechanism-ranking reversals）。这个效应不只出现在精确的二次动态里；在逐样本裁剪的私有逻辑回归（per-example-clipped private logistic regression）里也还存在，不过在我们研究的神经网络情形（neural regime）里，暂时还没有定论。这些结果说明：在评估时间相关隐私噪声时，优化器状态是一个被建模不足、但会影响决策的维度。
